title: Transparent backgrounds for GPT Image
summary:
Transparent GPT Image backgrounds, less repetitive text ads, and a fresh crop of community projects.

GPT Image generation and editing gained a `transparent=true` API parameter. It defaults to false, so existing requests keep their usual backgrounds.

Authenticated users with `show_ads` turned off no longer receive text-service ads. Other changes request contextual ads from Nex.Ad, avoid adding another ad when a conversation already contains one, and make sponsor and support labels more consistent.

The README was restored, and project listings added two Spanish-language creative tools—a slideshow maker and an image-based memory game—alongside Whizzy AI, Mindcraft, Minecraft agent projects, and a Telegram chatbot. Apparently Minecraft remains a reasonable place to test whether an agent can follow instructions.

highlights.title: Transparent GPT Image backgrounds
highlights.text: Add `transparent=true` to GPT Image generation or editing requests to get an image without a solid background. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
